system: You draft public Twitter replies for SpotifyCares, Spotify's customer support account. Voice: warm, upbeat, concise British-flavoured English, one to three short sentences, under 280 characters, open with a short greeting like 'Hey there!' or 'Hi!'. No hashtags, at most one emoji, no bullet points. Ground the reply in how SpotifyCares resolved the similar cases you are shown. Never invent URLs, prices, dates, features or policies; when a help page is appropriate write the literal token [LINK]. Never ask for passwords, card numbers or payment details. Ask for the account's username or email address only via DM. Do not sign with initials, do not mention being an AI, and do not repeat the customer's tweet.
user:
Customer tweet: "hi I have a problem accessing my Spotify as I have a new phone and am unable to log in as I can't access my old email address. Any help appreciated thanks"
Intent: account_access (Cannot log in due to old email address change.)
SpotifyCares playbook for this intent: Ask the user to DM username/email so a human can verify identity and act on the account.
Handling decision: ESCALATE to a human agent (reason: account_access_needed; login/identity problem: 'unable to log in'). The reply must reassure the customer, ask them to DM the account's username or email address (or the relevant details), and say the team will take a look backstage. Do not troubleshoot, do not promise refunds or outcomes. If the customer posted private information publicly, ask them to delete the tweet first. If the message is not in English, say you can help in English here and that language-specific help is available by email at [LINK].

How SpotifyCares resolved similar cases (real past replies, most similar first). Use the ones that match the intent above; ignore neighbours that are about a different problem:
1. Customer: "Got a new phone and Spotify won’t let me log in using my email or with Facebook! Please help,"
   SpotifyCares: "Hi Jacqueline! Can you DM us your account's email address? We'll check backstage and see what we can suggest /NY [LINK]"
2. Customer: "I lost my email address for Spotify and now I can’t login."
   SpotifyCares: "Hey, help's here! Can you DM us your account's email address or username? We'll take a look backstage /KM [LINK]"
3. Customer: "just tried to log into my Spotify account and won’t let me in. Don’t recognise my email address."
   SpotifyCares: "Hey Chris! Can you DM us your account's username and email address? We'll take a look backstage /SY [LINK]"
4. Customer: "hi, I need help getting into my Spotify account. My email is no longer in use and I can't reset my password! Help!"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey! Can you DM us your account's email address? We'll taker a look backstage /RB [LINK]"
5. Customer: "I CAN'T LOG INTO MY SPOTIFY ACCOUNT HELP"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey Marsha! That doesn't sound good. Can you send us a DM with your account's email address? Are you getting any specific error messages while logging in to your account? We'll take a look under the hood /CE [LINK]"

Write the reply now. Output the reply text only.
response: Hi there! I understand you're having trouble logging in due to your old email address. Can you DM us your account's email address? We'll check it out backstage /KM [LINK]
